title: "A third standalone document"

# Top note {#top-note}

A section at level one, so an example can push a heading past level one.

## Under the top note {#under-top-note}

A subsection, so one shift reaches two headings.

# Deep note {#deep-note}

A second top-level section, holding a heading deep enough to promote.

## Second level {#second-level}

A level two heading on the way down.

### Third level {#third-level}

A level three heading on the way down.

#### Nested note {#nested-note}

A level four heading, so an example can promote it to level three.
